--bronze layer creation
use bronze;
GO

-- read single csv file
select top 10*
from OPENROWSET(
    bulk 'trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/month=01/green_tripdata_2020-01.csv',
    data_source = 'bronze_source',
    format = 'csv',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) as t;
GO

--wildcard
select top 100 *
from OPENROWSET(
    bulk 'trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/**',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    format = 'csv',
    PARSER_VERSION ='2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = true
)as t;
Go

-- wilcard year month pattern
select top 50  *
from OPENROWSET(
    bulk 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    format = 'csv',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
)as t;
GO

--file name() and filepath() - 
select 
    t.filename() as source_file,
    t.filepath(1) as year_partitiion,
    t.filepath(2) as month_partition,
    *
    from openrowset(
           bulk 'trip_data_green_csv/year=*/month=*/*.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    format = 'csv',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE 
    )WITH(
        VendorID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        lpep_pickup_datetime VARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        lpep_dropoff_datatime VARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        store_and_fwd_flag VARCHAR(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        RateCodeID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        PULocationID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        DOLocationID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        passenger_count varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        trip_distance varchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        fare_amount varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        extra varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        mta_tax varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        tip_amount varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8, 
        tolls_amount varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        ehail_fee varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        improvement_surcharge varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        total_amount varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        payment_type varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        trip_type varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        congestion_surcharge varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
    ) as t;
    Go

-- bronze external table
if object_Id ('bronze.dbo.nyc_taxi_raw')is not null drop external table bronze.dbo.nyc_taxi_raw;

create external table nyc_taxi_raw(

        lpep_pickup_datetime VARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        lpep_dropoff_datatime VARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        store_and_fwd_flag VARCHAR(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        RateCodeID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        PULocationID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        DOLocationID varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        passenger_count varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        trip_distance varchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        fare_amount varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        extra varchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        mta_tax varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        tip_amount varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8, 
        tolls_amount varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        ehail_fee varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        improvement_surcharge varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        total_amount varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        payment_type varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        trip_type varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
        congestion_surcharge varchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
)with(
    location = 'trip_data_green_csv/**',
    data_source = bronze_source,
    file_format = csv_format
);
Go

--verify bronze
select top 10 * from nyc_taxi_raw;
select count(*) as total_raw_rows from nyc_taxi_raw;

USE bronze;
GO

-- Step 1: Just read the files with no filepath() 
-- to confirm files are accessible
SELECT TOP 5 *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'trip_data_green_parquet/**',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS t;
GO

-- Step 2: Check just filename to see what files exist
SELECT DISTINCT
    t.filename() AS file_name
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'trip_data_green_parquet/**',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS t;
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('bronze.dbo.taxi_parquet') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.dbo.taxi_parquet;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE taxi_parquet (
    VendorID                INT,
    lpep_pickup_datetime    DATETIME2,
    lpep_dropoff_datetime   DATETIME2,
    store_and_fwd_flag      VARCHAR(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    RatecodeID              INT,
    PULocationID            INT,
    DOLocationID            INT,
    passenger_count         INT,
    trip_distance           FLOAT,
    fare_amount             FLOAT,
    extra                   FLOAT,
    mta_tax                 FLOAT,
    tip_amount              FLOAT,
    tolls_amount            FLOAT,
    ehail_fee               int,
    improvement_surcharge   FLOAT,
    total_amount            FLOAT,
    payment_type            INT,
    trip_type               INT,
    congestion_surcharge    FLOAT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION    = 'trip_data_green_parquet/year=*/month=*/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = bronze_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format      -- correct name now
);
GO

-- Verify data loads
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM taxi_parquet;
GO

--Now filepath() will work correctly
-- Query with filepath() for year and month partitions
SELECT
    t.filename()                        AS source_file,
    t.filepath(1)                       AS year_partition,
    t.filepath(2)                       AS month_partition,
    VendorID,
    lpep_pickup_datetime,
    fare_amount,
    total_amount
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'trip_data_green_parquet/year=*/month=*/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'bronze_source',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS t
WHERE t.filepath(1) = '2021';           -- filter year 2021 using partition
GO

if object_ID('dbo.bronze.taxi_delta') is not NULL
    drop external table dbo.bronze.taxi_delta

drop external table taxi_delta;

select * from sys.external_tables;

create external table taxi_delta(
    VendorID                INT,
    lpep_pickup_datetime    DATETIME2,
    lpep_dropoff_datetime   DATETIME2,
    store_and_fwd_flag      VARCHAR(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    RatecodeID              INT,
    PULocationID            INT,
    DOLocationID            INT,
    passenger_count         INT,
    trip_distance           FLOAT,
    fare_amount             FLOAT,
    extra                   FLOAT,
    mta_tax                 FLOAT,
    tip_amount              FLOAT,
    tolls_amount            FLOAT,
    ehail_fee               int,
    improvement_surcharge   FLOAT,
    total_amount            FLOAT,
    payment_type            INT,
    trip_type               INT,
    congestion_surcharge    FLOAT
)
with(
    location = 'trip_data_green_delta',
    data_source = bronze_source,
    file_format = delta_format
);
GO

select top 10 * from taxi_delta;
